cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
include(ExternalProject)

#
# Top-level board selector.
#
# Each board is a self-contained STM32CubeMX project under boards/<board>/ (its own
# Core/ plus a duplicated copy of the vendor HAL in boards/<board>/{Drivers,Middlewares,
# Common}). Shared, portable code lives in src/ (and, for now, stm-2026-common/, being
# folded into src/). Pick a board with -DBOARD=fcu|ecu; defaults to fcu.
#
# This file is NOT generated by CubeMX (the CubeMX project root is boards/<board>/), so
# it is the durable place to own board selection and the CM7-only policy.
#

# In order to use CMake for cross-compiling
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FORCED "true")

if(NOT DEFINED BOARD)
    set(BOARD fcu)
endif()
message("Target board: ${BOARD}")

# CM7-only — neither board uses the CM4 core.
if(NOT DEFINED BUILD_CONTEXT)
    set(BUILD_CONTEXT CM7)
endif()

set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME firmware)
project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

# Handed to the board's CM7 build so it can reach the shared trees without
# depth-fragile ../.. paths.
set(REPO_ROOT ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})

# Build the selected board's CM7 application directly (the board's own
# CubeMX orchestrator under boards/<board>/ is left for CubeMX regen and is not used
# as the build entry point).
ExternalProject_Add(${BOARD}_CM7
    BINARY_DIR                  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/boards/${BOARD}/CM7/build
    SOURCE_DIR                  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/boards/${BOARD}/CM7
    PREFIX                      ${BOARD}
    CONFIGURE_HANDLED_BY_BUILD  true
    INSTALL_COMMAND             ""
    CMAKE_ARGS                  -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
                                -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE}
                                -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}
                                -DREPO_ROOT=${REPO_ROOT}
    BUILD_ALWAYS                true
)
